title: EMP from nuclear blast travels through dimensions
summary: Tom DeLonge tells of EMP from nuclear blast travels through dimensions, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The one thing we found out is that the EMP wave from a nuclear blast kind of travels through multiple dimensions.

plain: The musician Tom DeLonge says that the electromagnetic pulse from a nuclear explosion, the burst of energy that can knock out electronics, travels in some way through multiple dimensions. He presents it on Jesse Michels's show as something he and the people he works with found out from others, without saying who. If true, it would offer a reason why nuclear tests might draw the attention of whatever lies behind UFOs.
